newsitem.title: UK: Granada, Grand Met to open 75 restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Granada, Grand Met to open 75 restaurants.

text.p: Granada Group Plc and Burger King, the hamburger chain Grand Metropolitan Plc, said on Sunday that they have agreed to open up to 75 co-branded Burger King/Little Chef restaurants over the next two years.

The deal comes after a five month test involving the development of eight new Granada roadside units, four of which were converted from Little Chef to Burger King restaurants and four of which were co-branded units, with both Burger King and Little Chef operating side by side.
The two companies said the majority of the restaurants will become fully operational in 1997.
